buttons.annotation: Polygon Disc: Create a polygon disc on the grid
buttons.label: Polygon Disc

buttons.name: shelfButton8
buttons.annotation: Platonic Solid: Create a polygon polyhedron on the grid. Right-click for more polygon primitive types
buttons.label: Platonic Solid

buttons.name: shelfButton9
buttons.annotation:
Super Ellipse: Create a polygon super ellipse shape on the grid.
Right-click to choose shape type.
buttons.label: Super Ellipse

buttons.name: shelfButton10
buttons.annotation: Sweep Mesh: Create sweep mesh based on selected curve(s)
buttons.label: Sweep Mesh

buttons.name: shelfButton11
buttons.annotation: Polygon Type: Create 3D text on the grid
buttons.label: Polygon Type

buttons.name: shelfButton12
buttons.annotation: SVG: Create polygons using scalable vector graphics from the clipboard or an imported SVG file
buttons.label: SVG

buttons.name: shelfButton13
buttons.annotation: Content Browser: Browse assets and example content and import them into your scene
buttons.label: Content Browser

buttons.name: shelfButton14
buttons.annotation: Center Pivot: Resets the selected object's pivot to the center
buttons.label: Center Pivot

buttons.name: shelfButton15
buttons.annotation: Delete By Type: History: Delete construction history on the selected object(s)
buttons.label: Delete By Type: History

buttons.name: shelfButton16
buttons.annotation: Freeze Transformations: Select an object(s)
buttons.label: Freeze Transformations

buttons.name: shelfButton17
buttons.annotation: Difference (A - B): Subtracts the second selected object (B) from the first selected object (A). RMB: More operations. Right-click for more Boolean operations.
buttons.label: Difference (A - B)

buttons.name: shelfButton18
buttons.annotation: Combine: Combine the selected polygon objects into one single object to allow operations such as merges or face trims.
buttons.label: Combine

buttons.name: shelfButton19
buttons.annotation: Extract: Extract the currently selected faces from their shell and shows a manipulator to adjust their offset.
buttons.label: Extract

buttons.name: shelfButton20
buttons.annotation: Mirror: Mirror geometry across an axis.
buttons.label: Mirror

buttons.name: shelfButton21
buttons.annotation: Smooth: Add faces to the selected polygon objects to smooth them.
buttons.label: Smooth

buttons.name: shelfButton22
buttons.annotation: Reduce: Reduce number of polygonal components for selected objects.
buttons.label: Reduce

buttons.name: shelfButton23
buttons.annotation: Remesh: Redefines the topology of a mesh by splitting edges to add detail and/or collapsing edges to reduce detail. Use Remesh to create a uniformly tessellated triangular mesh.
buttons.label: Remesh

buttons.name: shelfButton24
buttons.annotation: Retopologize: Generates clean, new topology that preserves the shape of the source while converting the mesh into four-sided faces (quads).
buttons.label: Retopologize

buttons.name: shelfButton25
buttons.annotation: Extrude: Extend new vertices/edges/faces from existing spots on a mesh.
buttons.label: Extrude

buttons.name: shelfButton26
buttons.annotation: Smart Extrude: Perform a Smart Extrude operation on mesh faces to interactively clean up surrounding topology for optimal results.
buttons.label: Smart Extrude

buttons.name: shelfButton27
buttons.annotation: Bridge: Create a bridge between two sets of edges or faces
buttons.label: Bridge

buttons.name: shelfButton28
buttons.annotation: Bevel Components: Create a bevel along the selected edges or faces
buttons.label: Bevel Components

buttons.name: shelfButton29
buttons.annotation: Smart Bevel: Interactively bevel along selected edges for procedural results, regardless of topology.
buttons.label: Smart Bevel

buttons.name: shelfButton30
buttons.annotation: Merge: Merge vertices / border edges based on selection.
buttons.label: Merge

buttons.name: shelfButton31
buttons.annotation: Merge to Center: Merge selected components to their center point.
buttons.label: Merge to Center

buttons.name: shelfButton32
buttons.annotation: Flip Triangle Edge: Flip the edge between two triangles
buttons.label: Flip Triangle Edge

buttons.name: shelfButton33
buttons.annotation: Duplicate: Duplicate the currently selected faces in a new object.
buttons.label: Duplicate

buttons.name: shelfButton34
buttons.annotation: Collapse: Removes selected components by merging their adjacent vertices.
buttons.label: Collapse

buttons.name: shelfButton35
buttons.annotation: Circularize: Organize the vertices of selected components into a circle that aligns to the mesh surface.
buttons.label: Circularize

buttons.name: shelfButton36
buttons.annotation: Multi-Cut: Cut, slice and insert edges on polygons.
buttons.label: Multi-Cut

buttons.name: shelfButton37
buttons.annotation: Target Weld: Merges two edges or vertices into a single component.
buttons.label: Target Weld

buttons.name: shelfButton38
buttons.annotation: Quad Draw: Drop points on Live objects to create new faces for re-topology
buttons.label: Quad Draw
